2.title: The Best-Selling AOC Sparkling Wine in France
2.html:
With its distinctive personality and impeccable quality, Crémant d'Alsace is now the best-selling AOC sparkling wine for home consumption in France, and does well in overseas markets too. Average annual production is currently about 29 million bottles, about 19% of total Alsace production.

In the French domestic market, Crémant d'Alsace holds first place among all AOC sparkling wines with a 36.9% market share — far ahead of second-placed Clairette de Die (15.5%), Saumur (10%) and Blanquette de Limoux (4.8%).
3.title: Explosive Growth: 13-Fold in 25 Years
3.html:
Until 1979, production of Crémant d'Alsace was less than 1 million bottles. Since then market demand has kept climbing, and sales grew 13-fold in 25 years: from 2.2 million bottles in 1982 to a surge of 28 million in 2007.

In terms of distribution of consumption, it is concentrated mainly in the Grand Est region (34%), followed by the North (23%), the West (18%) and the Paris region (10%). Although the domestic market still accounts for the great majority (83%), exports to Europe and the United States are also growing. To some extent this explosive growth has also eased the economic pressure the Alsace wine industry has faced in recent years.

4.explanation: With a 36.9% market share, Crémant d'Alsace is the best-selling AOC sparkling wine for home consumption in France, far ahead of second-placed Clairette de Die (15.5%), Saumur (10%) and Blanquette de Limoux (4.8%). Sales grew 13-fold in 25 years (2.2 million bottles in 1982 → 28 million in 2007), one of the most impressive growth stories of the Alsace wine industry in recent years.
